treatments_received: arthroscopy and closed manipulation of the shoulder
surgery for correction of a severe mal-union of a proximal humeral fracture
treatments_future: future visits to medical advisers (as claimed by Mr. Joy)

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Mr. Joy had to give up, inter alia, golf, tennis, sailing, swimming, jogging and even deep-sea and fresh water fishing; also had to give up working in his garden.
Madam Lee suffers from post-traumatic dementia, post-concussional syndrome, post-traumatic stress disorder and depression; her permanent incapacity is placed between 75% and 80%.
Mr. Lam has loss of hearing on one high frequency level in the right ear and continued tinnitus.
Mr. Lam has loss of movement of the neck due to neck pain and loss of grip strength.
Conventional award for loss of expectation of life for deceased (e.g. Chan Tin Shun, Wu Yuk Ngan, Luk Siu Sze) assessed at $30,000.00 each (conventional award).
Madam Ho: there is no realistic likelihood of her ever working again; previously ran the home and worked in a garment factory.
